name: OpenAI Compatible LLM
description: OpenAI compatible chat API for terminal state classification
author: Vibe Terminal

config_fields.label: API Key
config_fields.description: API key for authentication (leave empty if not required)

config_fields.label: Extra Body
config_fields.description: JSON object merged into the completion request body. Use to add model-specific parameters, e.g. {"extra_body": {"enable_thinking": false}} for Qwen, {"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}} for DeepSeek

config_fields.label: Max Input Tokens
config_fields.description: Maximum number of input tokens used when preparing prompts and agent context.

config_fields.label: Max Output Tokens
config_fields.description: Maximum number of completion tokens requested from the model.

config_fields.label: Timeout (seconds)
config_fields.description: Per-request timeout in seconds applied to every HTTP call this addon makes. Increase it for slow models.
